content: Bana bakhunda hika mu lukwikilu, lwenina mwena Kidisitu
Kwena meni baphangi, yíluzonzisaku hanga batu bana benina mu kitembu: kaasi yímeka kuluzonzisa hanga batu ba kimutu, hanga kwena bana bakhunda mu lukwikilu mwena Kidisitu.
Midiki yíluheka, ka madya ma ngolu ku, mukuma wadi madya ma ngolu lwakhanamoku lenda mu kumina. Amana keti buthwena bwabu phi, lwalendamoku mu kumina,
kikuma mu kimutu lwenina kaka. Bwosu lwenina yi kiphala yi kutendana mu kati dya benu, mambu mana moosu misi songila ni lwisi dyatila hanga batu ba kimutu.
Ho mosi wa benu kazimbula: «Meni wa Pholu», amana mukwawu kazimbula: «Meni wa Apholosi», kima kyahika lwenina ho batu kwandi
Amana nati Apholosi? Nati phi Pholu? Basadi ba Nzambi benina, muna nzila ya kisalu kya bawu ndangu benu lwakwikila. Kosu mutu kisi sala kisalu kina kámuheka Pfumu.
Meni, miti yíkuna, Apholosi yandi mamba kátyakila, kaasi Nzambi wakalawa kodisa
Yihana ni, mutu wuna wisi kuna miti yi wuna wisi tyakila mamba balutiku: kaasi Nzambi wuna wisiwa kodisa, yandi wulutini.
Mutu wuna wisi kuna miti yi wuna wisiwa tyakila mamba kima kimosi benina; kaasi kosu mutu katambula lufutu lwandi bwosu kasadidini kisalu kya yandi meni.
Mukuma betu thwenina bakwetu ba kisalu ba Nzambi. Benu lwenina kilanga kya Nzambi, thungidi ya Nzambi.

Bwosu bwenina mu kabu dya khenda dina kápheka Nzambi, yítunga kedi mipfundila hanga mutungi wa bukheti wa nzu. Amana buthwena bwabu, mutu wahika wisi tunga hana thandu. Kaasi kosu mutu kakeba mu thungidi.
Kikuma mipfundila mya kusikula kedi myenina muna Yesu Kidisitu, kweku mutu wahika fwani kasikula mikwawu.
Amana yuka ni mutu katungila, hana tandu ya mupfundila, mu wolu, phalata, mu matadi ma thalu, mu miti, mu mwangu watsi yi khangu
Kaasi muhangu wa kosu mutu wázayakana mu kilumbu kya pfundusu. Kikuma, mu mbawu batésilawa muhangu wa kosu mutu; mu kuzaya buna wenina muhangu wa wandi.
Ho ni muhangu wa mutu wuna katungini wazyama, yandi katámbula lufutu.
Kaasi, ho ni muhangu wa mutu wahya ku mbawu, mukwa wawu katámbulaku lufutu; yandi meni kahúluka, hanga mutu wulutidi ha mbawu.
Luzayibwoku ni benu lwenina nzu ya Nzambi, amana Kitembu kya Nzambi mwena benu kisi zingila.
Yihana ni, mutu wuna wazánga nzu ya Nzambi, Nzambi kamúzanga; mukuma nzu ya Nzambi yenina yatoma; yi benu, nzu ya Nzambi meni yina.
Ka mutu ku kadihuna yandi meni: ni ho mutu, mukati dya benu, wuzodi ni kadikitula mutu wadimuka mu mambu ma tsi yayi, theti kakituka kilawu amana kakituka nana mutu wadimuka.
Kikuma mudimu wa tsi yayi wenina hanga kilawu ku thwala ya Nzambi. Mukuma básonika bwabu: «Nzambi kisi kwata batu badimuka ha mutambu wa nduka za bawu meni za mbi.»
Amana hika: «Pfumu wuzayini mabanza ma batu badimuka, wuzayima ni ma phamba menina.»
Amana ka mutu ku wadizatula ku mambu ma batu. Mukuma mambu moosu ma benu menina:
kondilo Pholu, Apholosi, Sefwasi, tsi, luzingu, lufwa, lelu kondilo mbasi, byosu bya benu;
kaasi benu lwenina batu ba Kidisitu amana Kidisitu kenina wa Nzambi.
